title: [Error] Master - follower issue with Huawei P40 lite
symptom: A new Huawei P40 lite phone without Google Play Services was set as follower for group sync, but it is not receiving data from the master. The master is not sending information to followers over mobile network unless connected to WiFi or hotspot.
fix: The developer suggests using Nightscout for followers to work without Google Play Services.
evidence_quote: You should upload to nightscout and followers will download from there
